Verbatim license texts used as test fixtures, so detection is checked against the
real documents rather than hand-written snippets.

Copied from Debian's `/usr/share/common-licenses`. The texts belong to their
publishers: the Free Software Foundation (GPL-2, GPL-3, LGPL-2.1, LGPL-3), the
Mozilla Foundation (MPL-2.0) and the Apache Software Foundation (Apache-2.0). Each
license permits verbatim copying of its own text.
